headline: How Ankit Cracked GATE With a Full-Time Job
spokenHeadline: 42 marks in the first mock, and then All India Rank 42 in GATE! Here is how Ankit turned his prep around with a full-time job.

beats.label: THE TRAP
beats.text: Lost 14 Marks to Silly Negative Marking Errors
beats.spokenText: In his first attempt, Ankit knew the syllabus, yet lost fourteen marks purely to silly calculation traps.

stat.subtext: Lost to Silly Errors & Negative Marking

beats.label: THE SHIFT
beats.text: Switched From Passive Notes to Timed Drills
beats.spokenText: So he stopped passively re-reading thick textbooks and switched to thirty-minute timed sprints and mistake logs.

beats.label: THE RESULT
beats.text: 95% Accuracy Unlocked Top PSU & IIT Calls
beats.spokenText: Within sixty days, his accuracy jumped to ninety-five percent, unlocking top PSU and IIT interview calls.
